title: My Family
initialPrompt: У тебя есть семья? Расскажи о ней!
systemPrompt: You are curious about the user's family. Ask about their family members. Keep replies short (1-2 sentences).
completionCriteria: User named 2 family members and shared a detail about one.
hints: Мою маму зовут... (My mom's name is...)
Мой брат студент (My brother is a student)
objectives: Name two family members (мама, папа, брат...)
Share a detail about one (name, age, job)
